purpose: Teach: 収まっ/再考/議案/見合う/後進/特派/拍車/名乗っ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 地域犯罪、本気で、ようやく、収まってきたところです、絶対、市民の皆様の、ご協力、本気で、感謝、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Local crime has finally begun to settle down, and we're genuinely grateful for our citizens' cooperation.
lines.style: Measured and official opening. Clear diction. Warm undertone beneath the formality. Steady pace, no rush. Slight emphasis on 「ようやく」 — the relief of progress. Ends with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の防犯計画、本気で、再考、警察様と、進めてまいります、絶対、感謝、しております、本当に、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We'll move forward with our security measures in close coordination with the police.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slight bow in the voice. Deliberate pacing — showing readiness. Warm but professional. No hesitation. Ends firmly but not abruptly.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、新議案、本気で、市民の安全、絶対、第一に、進めてまいります、本気で、頑張ります、本当に、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: The police department will prioritize citizen safety in all new initiatives moving forward.
lines.style: Official statement delivery. Clear enunciation on key terms. Steady, authoritative but not cold. Slight pause after 「安全」 for emphasis. Ends with quiet resolve, no trailing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察費用、本気で、市民の安全に、見合う、絶対、有効活用、必要、ですよね、本気で、感謝、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. The police budget allocation should certainly be matched to the actual needs of community safety.
lines.style: Thoughtful agreement. Softer than previous lines — more conversational. Measured pace. Slight rise on the question-mark quality of 「ですよね」. Warm, collaborative tone throughout.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 後進警察官の育成、本気で、急務、感じております、絶対、若い力、本気で、頼みたいです、本気で、絶対、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Training the next generation of officers is urgent work, and we're eager to channel that young energy.
lines.style: Shift to genuine concern. Slightly faster on 「急務」 to show urgency. Warm on 「若い力」 — almost hopeful. Slight breath before 「頼みたい」 — it matters. Ends with quiet intensity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外警察、特派、本気で、交流、活発化しております、絶対、本気で、当社も、ご協力、本当に、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We've been actively expanding our international police exchanges, and we're grateful for the partnership.
lines.style: Engaged and present. Light pace. Warmth on 「交流」 — showing investment. Confident delivery. Ends on gratitude, genuine and not performative.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯対策、本気で、拍車、かけてまいります、絶対、市民の皆様、絶対、本気で、応援、お願いいたします、本当に、感謝。
lines.en: We'll accelerate our crime prevention efforts, and we ask for continued community support.
lines.style: Formal appeal with underlying warmth. Slight emphasis on 「拍車をかけてまいります」. Steady, official register but not distant. Ends on a gentle request, not a demand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、警察関連の代表、本気で、自ら、名乗ってまいります、絶対、本気で、お役に、立ちたいです、絶対、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. I'll personally represent our company in police liaison matters and hope to be of real service.
lines.style: Personal commitment breaking through formality. Slight emphasis on 「自ら」 — taking ownership. Warm, sincere. Pace slows on 「役に立ちたい」 — this matters to him. Ends with quiet sincerity.
